items.title: Josephine Davies interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 14, 2025
items.q: I heard this beautiful thing yesterday which was something about we have so little knowledge really about what consciousness is... [Interviewer mentions conversation with Maria Schneider] ... [Interviewee] Yup. Absolutely. Yeah. 100 percent I support that statement.

ctx.x: So do you have interests outside of your projects, which are numerous and varied?

Yes certainly. I’m an avid reader so I’m just always looking for – sometimes it’s new information but also I’m an avid reader of novels. Oddly enough I was just thinking about this yesterday. Somebody asked me one of those impossible questions – it’s an impossible, it’s a ridiculous question, but he said, “Would you rather go blind or deaf?” you know that old sort of mental acrobatics to try to imagine yourself into either of those © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-

things which is of course impossible when you have both of those faculties. But it was a real struggle because I thought reading for me is as important as music in some ways, to really lose myself in a world that somebody else has imagined and then is giving to me through the means of the page, where I’m – as I’m reading their world I’m creating my own world. And I think there is something so fundamentally important about that for me that I’m not sure I could be a composer or a musician if I couldn’t experience…
